definition.name: 新增用户自然日次日留存
definition.definition: 新增注册用户第二天回来产生会话的比例。
definition.numerator: D 日注册且 D+1 有至少一次会话的去重 user_id 数
definition.denominator: D 日首次注册去重用户数；为零则不可计算
definition.dimensions: users.registration_os / registration_version / channel 固定注册归属
definition.joins: users.user_id = sessions.user_id；EXISTS 防止多会话重复计数
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai 自然日；注册窗口 [start,end)；D+1 完整结束且 users/sessions 水位齐备；D+2 <= sessions.complete_before
definition.pitfalls: 不是滚动 24 小时；不混入活跃老用户；跨日用总留存/总新增，不平均每日比例

parameters.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
        SELECT u.registration_os,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
        SELECT period,registration_os,COUNT(*) AS users,SUM(retained) AS retained,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS retention_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-01' ELSE '2026-01-08' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period,registration_os ORDER BY period,registration_os

          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')

          SUM(retained)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS retention_rate,

          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period,registration_os ORDER BY period,registration_os

definition.name: 新增用户自然日次日留存
definition.definition: 新增注册用户第二天回来产生会话的比例。
definition.numerator: D 日注册且 D+1 有至少一次会话的去重 user_id 数
definition.denominator: D 日首次注册去重用户数；为零则不可计算
definition.dimensions: users.registration_os / registration_version / channel 固定注册归属
definition.joins: users.user_id = sessions.user_id；EXISTS 防止多会话重复计数
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai 自然日；注册窗口 [start,end)；D+1 完整结束且 users/sessions 水位齐备；D+2 <= sessions.complete_before
definition.pitfalls: 不是滚动 24 小时；不混入活跃老用户；跨日用总留存/总新增，不平均每日比例

baseline_results.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
        SELECT u.registration_os,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
        SELECT period,registration_os,COUNT(*) AS users,SUM(retained) AS retained,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS retention_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-01' ELSE '2026-01-08' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period,registration_os ORDER BY period,registration_os

        SELECT u.registration_os,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
        SELECT period,registration_os,COUNT(*) AS users,SUM(retained) AS retained,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS retention_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-01' ELSE '2026-01-08' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period,registration_os ORDER BY period,registration_os

definition.name: 新增用户自然日次日留存
definition.definition: 新增注册用户第二天回来产生会话的比例。
definition.numerator: D 日注册且 D+1 有至少一次会话的去重 user_id 数
definition.denominator: D 日首次注册去重用户数；为零则不可计算
definition.dimensions: users.registration_os / registration_version / channel 固定注册归属
definition.joins: users.user_id = sessions.user_id；EXISTS 防止多会话重复计数
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai 自然日；注册窗口 [start,end)；D+1 完整结束且 users/sessions 水位齐备；D+2 <= sessions.complete_before
definition.pitfalls: 不是滚动 24 小时；不混入活跃老用户；跨日用总留存/总新增，不平均每日比例

candidates.explanation: 总体观测留存近似稳定，基期结构标准化显示恶化；系统新增占比变化抵消部分分群恶化。

statistical_limitations: 全窗口成熟注册用户计数加权，不平均每日比例。
标准化为派生比较量，不是二项样本，不发布二项区间。
未建立样本精度及独立同质抽样条件，不能判断总体过程是否异常；极小分群样本的比例尤其不稳定，候选仅描述当前快照，不代表证据充分。
5 个百分点为开发描述性业务阈值；总体差值未达阈值仅表示观测近似稳定，不证明统计等效。
unexcluded_factors: 系统内渠道和版本构成、采集质量及同期产品变化仍未排除；不证明因果，也不泛称辛普森悖论。

published_report.summary: 证据支持当前快照的描述性候选，尚未证明总体推断或因果关系。

semantic_acceptance: not_claimed; independent human assessment required for diagnosis
